name: standing-calf-machine-shrug
instructions:
1. Assume a standing position in a calf raise machine with your shoulders against the pad and knees bent.
2. Inhale and stand up straight by extending the knees.
3. Contract your traps into the shoulder pads to elevate the shoulders. Squeeze hard at the top and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
